subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four stale assertions are repaired and exact-head checks pass, should the security owners accept these credential-bearing GitHub Action revisions as one grouped update?
rationale: The assertion repair is mechanical and the proposed SHAs match upstream release tags, but accepting new third-party executable code in token, registry, release, agent, and scanning workflows requires explicit security-owner intent.

options.title: Approve the verified group
options.body: Accept the grouped revisions after guard synchronization and a green exact-head validation run.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate token, Docker, Codex, release, and CodeQL revisions into narrower security-owner review units.

options.title: Pause the update
options.body: Retain the existing pins until the privileged dependency revisions can be reviewed safely.

recommendation.title: Approve the verified group
recommendation.body: Accept the grouped revisions after guard synchronization and a green exact-head validation run.
